## Description

Each existing or reported allergy must be set to Confirmed / Patient reported / Unknown / Not an allergy; new allergies can be added with reaction. Medicines captured as patient-reported (name, dose, frequency) or "Needs clarification" for unknown names. "Hand off · Ready for doctor" is disabled with "Confirm allergy status to hand off" until every allergy has a status; handoff moves the board card to Ready for doctor.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Handoff is impossible (UI and API) while any allergy lacks a status.
- [ ] **AC2.** Allergy statuses and medicine statements store source (nurse intake, patient) and actor.
- [ ] **AC3.** Handoff updates the board and Today in real time.
- [ ] **AC4.** "No known allergies" must be explicitly confirmed; it is never the default.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
